seed_rule: Legacy descriptive label: A beats B only when medians differ by more than both spreads. Not used as the decision; see prospective.

inference_policy.descriptive_historical: observed runs; no causal or prospective claim
inference_policy.prospective: requires --pair; d = A - B; bootstrap CI; censoring reported
inference_policy.pairing: predeclared pairing only; matching RNG seeds alone is not enough
inference_policy.pilot_warning: five pairs is a pilot, not a significance guarantee
